units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> <he>הדָּשׁ</he> he who threshes (on the Sabbath); a. fr.—Euphem. for sexual contact.
Pes. 87ᵇ; a. e.—דוש בעקב to trample with one’s heel, to treat lightly, not to heed.

<cite ref="Megillah 24b:12">Meg. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>אם היה דש בעירו</he> if he has been a familiar figure in his town (so that people do not mind his bodily disfigurement); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:1:4">Y. Taan. IV, beg. 67ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:25">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>הייתם מְדַיְּישִׁין את העץ וכ׳</he> you used to tread upon this piece of wood.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 8:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. VIII, 3</cite> <he>מְדַיֵּישׁ עליך כעפר</he> even one who treads upon thee as upon dust.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:12">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>דַּיְּישֵׁם</he> tread upon them.
